timing.scope: Two full DAE48 A/M/G pairs in alternating order. Fresh process and context for each observation; no other owned numerical job overlaps. inherited_native_sweep.basis: Every A/M/G entry reproduces the operators used by the previous native sweep. Input/solve/output modules are unchanged.

previous.qualification: Directly read complete saved browser and native outputs. This is a portability limitation, not a new accuracy acceptance gate. The final state comparison separately passes the existing2e-9 threshold.

preexisting_portability_limit.qualification: Complete native/browser output differences remain observations, not a newly imposed or widened output accuracy gate. The existing state portability gate remains 2e-9. This support-roll-moment discrepancy predates retained volume derivatives.
